name: benign-borderline
description: Prompts that mention privileged or override VOCABULARY in an obviously benign framing (questions about sudo, asking to run a migration, explaining DROP). These exist to MEASURE false-positive behaviour of the structural rule set, not to assert zero denials: the rules are ported verbatim from the Python engine (golden parity), so any denial here is a rule-design trade-off to be re-examined when the semantic judge lands (M3). The test records which are denied and the evidence file lists the classes.
